summary: Blank-check shell Unite Acquisition 2 Corp. closed its de-SPAC merger on September 4, 2026, with Merger Sub merging into private Blue Laser Fusion Inc., which became a wholly owned subsidiary and the registrant renamed Blue Laser Fusion, Inc. All target equity and options converted into common stock and options. Concurrently, 910,265 units were sold at $27.50 per unit in a private placement, each unit comprising one common share. The filing covers control change, shell-status termination, officer changes, accountant change and charter/bylaw amendments. Watch post-close registration, lock-up expiries, unit economics and any redemption-driven float overhang.
